The BIMLash Solution

A Step Towards Semantic Heritage Modelling

BIMLash is a custom Revit add-in that brings point clouds directly into the BIM environment, inside Autodesk Revit, and converts them into mesh geometry without leaving the software.

1

Point clouds straight into Revit

Point cloud data is loaded directly into the BIM environment, so there is no need to move between separate software platforms.

2

Any point cloud to mesh

BIMLash converts any point cloud into mesh geometry directly within Revit, ready to support heritage documentation.

3

Accuracy set by the user

The user chooses the level of accuracy of the generated mesh, balancing detail against processing needs.

Why it was developed

BIM modellers, BIM specialists, and HBIM practitioners struggle to convert point cloud data into modelling-ready geometry, because existing Scan-to-HBIM workflows are time-consuming, highly manual, prone to inconsistencies, and often require multiple software platforms. BIMLash was built to address these challenges.

What it brings

  • Less time. A faster route from point cloud data to usable BIM geometry.
  • Less manual work. Less dependence on user expertise, with more consistent results and better geometric accuracy.
  • One integrated workflow. Everything happens inside Revit, reducing the number of tools, plugins, and workflows needed.
